featured_reviews.name: mustafa shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I deeply regret purchasing two premium water purifiers (Lexzon - Alkaline with copper technology) from National Water Solutions, owned by Mukhtar. Initially, everything seemed fine – but things took a U-turn once I replaced all the filters as per their recommendation.

Let me break down the nightmare:

HORRIBLE after-sales service. They don’t respond after one or two calls – you have to keep chasing them like a beggar just to get basic service.

Their technicians are outright frauds. When I had water flow issues, their so-called "service agent" bypassed all the internal filters and connected the purifier directly to the tap water. I REPEAT – my family and I were unknowingly drinking untreated tap water for days!

Only when a new technician came and opened the machine in front of me did I find out about this disgusting malpractice. And when I reported this to Mukhtar, instead of apologizing, he shouted at his own technician for "opening the machine in front of the customer." Really? So hiding the fraud was more important than customer safety?

Then came the shameless money grab: I was asked to pay ₹1000 more for replacing two "faulty" parts. A month later – same story. Machine stops working, two other filters fail, and again they demand more money!

And when I asked why the filters failed so soon, he arrogantly told me there’s no guarantee despite earlier claiming they’d last several months.

This is nothing short of daylight robbery and a serious health risk.

I am now in the process of filing a formal complaint with the relevant consumer and regulatory authorities. Businesses like this need to be exposed and held accountable. Please do yourself a favour and stay far away from National Water Solutions.

Out of frustration, I called the official Aquaguard service team. On inspection, they clearly identified that the filters installed were fake:

QR code was not scanning

Overall build quality was not genuine

❗ Please be careful and avoid such service providers. Always go with authorized service to ensure genuine parts or check the products beforehand.
